item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I have a suggestion.

In the first part of the story it is mentioned how only the products by the door are lit up and everything else is pitch black, which hides the mummy surprise.

Then at the end with the part by the sample dispenser suddenly the mummy is magically visible from store floor?

This broke my immersion.

How about adding some kind of previously-dead interior freezer light bulb that flickers to life briefly so it makes sense that the mummy becomes visible from the store floor?

Or if not, make the way the mummy appears visible even more inexplicably anomalous in a way that makes it get shrugged off by the reader because "magic ain't gotta explain $%@t"
